label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Phil’s Ex-Caddie Joins PGA Tour
items.text: Jon Yarbrough, formerly Phil Mickelson’s caddie on LIV Golf, has joined Ben Griffin's bag for the Mexico Open after the PGA Tour’s LIV player ban does not apply to caddies.

items.headline: PNC Field Adds Korda, Young
items.text: Nelly Korda and Cameron Young will join their fathers in the 2026 PNC Championship, which now features a record four female competitors and awaits Tiger Woods’ potential return.

items.headline: 2027 PGA Tour Champions Schedule
items.text: The 2027 PGA Tour Champions schedule is set, with the Sony Hawaii move suggesting possible further tournament displacements ahead.
